titulo_es.@es: Estilo indirecto: contar lo que alguien dijo
titulo_es.@en: Indirect style: tell what someone said

consejo.@es: Suele significar «normal» o «corriente»; en España, «ordinario» también puede significar «vulgar».
consejo.@en: It usually means «normal» or «current»; in Spain, «ordinario» can also mean «vulgar».

texto.@es: Con un verbo de reporte en pasado, el tiempo suele retroceder: **“I am tired,” he said → He said (that) he was tired.** **“I will call,” she said → She said she would call.** **“I can help,” he said → He said he could help.**
texto.@en: With a report verb in the past, time is often back: **“I am tired,” he said → He said (that) he was tired.** **“I will call,” she said → She said she would call.** **“I can help,” he said → He said he could help.**

texto.@es: Si la información sigue siendo cierta o relevante, también puede mantenerse el presente: **“I live here,” she said → She said (that) she lives here.** El retroceso es habitual, pero no automático.
texto.@en: If the information remains true or relevant, the present can also be maintained: **“I live here,” she said → She said (that) she lives here.** The regression is usual, but not automatic.

texto.@es: **Say** suele centrarse en las palabras: **He said, “I'm tired.”** Si mencionas a quién, usa **to**: **He said to me, “I'm tired.”** En estilo indirecto puedes decir **He said (that) he was tired**. **Tell** suele centrarse en el mensaje y va seguido de la persona: **He told me (that) he was tired**. No se dice «He said me…» ni «He told that…» en este uso.
texto.@en: **Say** usually focuses on the words: **He said, “I'm tired.”** If you mention who, use **to**: **He said to me, “I'm tired.”** In indirect style you can say **He said (that) he was tired**. **Tell** usually focuses on the message and is followed by the person: **He told me (that) he was tired**. «He said me…» or «He told that…» is not said for this use.

texto.@es: **Explain**, **admit** y **complain** pueden introducir una oración con **that**: **He explained that the bus was late; he admitted that he had forgotten the keys; I complained that the bus was late.**
texto.@en: **Explain**, **admit** and **complain** can enter a sentence with **that**: **He explained that the bus was late; he admitted that he had forgotten the keys; I complained that the bus was late.**

frases.en: I told her I would come later.
frases.es: Le dije que vendría más tarde.

frases.en: Did he admit that he had forgotten the keys?
frases.es: ¿Admitió que se había olvidado de las llaves?

frases.en: He explained that the bus was late.
frases.es: Explicó que el autobús iba con retraso.

frases.en: She said she could help us.
Really? She refused to help us yesterday.
frases.es: ¿De verdad? Ayer se negó a ayudarnos.

frases.en: She said it was an ordinary day.
frases.es: Dijo que era un día normal.

frases.en: I'll remember to call her tomorrow.

pregunta.@en: What does «He said he was tired» mean?

explicacion.@es: Estilo indirecto: am pasa a was.
explicacion.@en: Indirect style: am passes to was.

explicacion.@es: Eso expresa un reporte en presente: «He says he is tired»; aquí el original usa «said».
explicacion.@en: That expresses a report in present: «He says he is tired»; here the original uses «said».

explicacion.@es: Eso sería futuro.
explicacion.@en: That would be future.

opciones.texto: She told me that she was ready.

explicacion.@es: Tell va seguido de la persona: told me.
explicacion.@en: Tell is followed by the person: tell me.

opciones.texto: She said me that she was ready.

explicacion.@es: Con say, la persona se introduce con «to»: She said to me…
explicacion.@en: With say, the person gets in with «to»: She said to me

opciones.texto: She told that she was ready.

explicacion.@es: En este uso, tell necesita indicar a quién se lo dijo.
explicacion.@en: In this use, tell you who you told.

bloques.frase: He explained that the bus was late.

opciones.texto: Explicó que el autobús iba con retraso.

explicacion.@es: «Was late» indica que el autobús iba con retraso.
explicacion.@en: «Was late» indicates that the bus was late.

opciones.texto: Explica que el autobús llega tarde.

explicacion.@es: Esta opción está en presente.
explicacion.@en: This option is present.

opciones.texto: Explicará que el autobús llegará tarde.

explicacion.@es: Esta opción está en futuro.
explicacion.@en: This option is in the future.

bloques.frase: She said, “I can help.” → She said she ___ help.

explicacion.@es: El retroceso habitual de «can» es «could».
explicacion.@en: The usual «can» regression is «could».

explicacion.@es: Puede mantenerse si sigue siendo cierto o relevante, pero aquí se pide el retroceso habitual.
explicacion.@en: It can be maintained if it is still true or relevant, but here the usual regression is called for.

explicacion.@es: «Would» es el retroceso de «will», no de «can».
explicacion.@en: «Would» is the «will» regression, not «can».

bloques.frase: She told him, “I will come later.” → She told him she ___ come later.

explicacion.@es: El retroceso habitual de «will» es «would».
explicacion.@en: The usual «will» regression is «would».

explicacion.@es: Puede mantenerse si la promesa sigue vigente, pero aquí se pide el retroceso habitual.
explicacion.@en: It can be maintained if the promise is still in place, but here is a call for the usual setback.

explicacion.@es: «Can» expresa posibilidad o capacidad, no es el retroceso de «will».
explicacion.@en: «Can» expresses possibility or capacity, is not the «will» regression.

bloques.audio: I forgot my keys at home.

explicacion.@es: Forgot = olvidé.
explicacion.@en: Forgot = I forgot.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería «remember».
explicacion.@en: That would be «remember».

opciones.texto: Me quejo de mis llaves en casa.

explicacion.@es: Eso sería «complain».
explicacion.@en: That would be «complain».

bloques.frase: He said he would call me

explicacion.@es: Will pasa a would.
explicacion.@en: Will's going to be.

pregunta.@es: Escribe en inglés: «Me quejé de que el autobús iba con retraso.»
pregunta.@en: Write in English: «I complained that the bus was late.»

respuestas: I complained that the bus was late.

explicacion.@es: «Complain» puede llevar una oración con «that»; para indicar el motivo con un sustantivo, usa «about» (complain about the delay).
explicacion.@en: «Complain» can carry a prayer with «that»; to indicate the motive with a noun, use «about» (complain about the delay).

intro.@es: En estilo indirecto, los pronombres y los tiempos pueden cambiar. Practica el retroceso habitual y observa cuándo se mantiene el presente.
intro.@en: In indirect style, pronouns and times can change. Practice the usual regression and watch when the present is maintained.
